body.x: As CES 2026 approaches, the focus once again shifts to robotics—a field that is rapidly transforming how people live, work, and interact. This year’s event promises an impressive lineup of innovations illustrating how robots are becoming deeply integrated into modern life, from smart homes and healthcare to hospitality, retail, and logistics.

No longer limited to industrial assembly lines, robots are now entering homes as practical helpers and even companions. One highlight from CES 2025 is Tombot’s Jennie, a robotic dog designed to provide emotional support to individuals with dementia and cognitive conditions. Meanwhile, Segway’s Navimow and Daedong’s multifunctional agricultural robot are revolutionizing outdoor maintenance and precision farming through autonomous operation and smart navigation.

Household robotics continues to advance with designs that combine utility and intelligence. Roborock’s Saros Z70, a vacuum cleaner equipped with a mechanical arm capable of moving small objects, demonstrates how automation extends beyond cleaning. Similarly, Samsung’s Ballie, a mobile home assistant, helps manage daily tasks while providing real-time updates such as weather and calendar alerts—marking a new era of personalized robotic companionship.

In the service and retail sectors, robots are transforming customer experiences. Richtech Robotics’ Adam, a robotic bartender and barista, is redefining hospitality service with style and efficiency. In retail settings, Kroger’s aisle-scanning robots streamline inventory management, while HERE Technologies advances autonomous navigation systems that enable precise indoor and outdoor mobility.

Driven by advancements in AI, machine learning, and automation, the global robotics industry continues to grow at an unprecedented rate. The U.S. home robotics market value has now reached approximately $1.1 billion, with the worldwide market projected to reach $178.63 billion by 2030. The rise of Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models further accelerates adoption by lowering costs and offering scalable automation solutions for small and medium-sized businesses.

As robots assume increasingly sophisticated roles—enhancing agricultural productivity, improving factory safety, and bringing empathy into human-machine interactions—CES 2026 will serve as a key showcase of how robotics is evolving from a tool of efficiency into an intelligent and caring partner.

From smart factories to emotional AI-driven companions, the world’s largest tech event will provide a glimpse into a near future where robots are not just machines but meaningful participants in our everyday lives. Visitors to CES 2026 in Las Vegas (January 6–9) will be among the first to see these breakthroughs firsthand, witnessing the next major leap in the human-robot relationship.
